record.field: Put a new tenant in a unit, give them a login, and photograph the rooms.

ol.li: Pick the Unit and the Tenant. If the tenant is new, type their name and press Create.
Check the start date, the monthly rent and the Deposit. The deposit is the money you hold for the tenant.
Press Start lease. The unit becomes occupied, the deposit is noted, and a move-in photo list is opened.
Press Create tenant login. Keep the password the system suggests, or type your own, then press Create login.
Press Print welcome sheet and give it to the tenant. The password is shown only once.
Open Moving in and out, then Inspections. Add one photo of every room, then press Finish inspection. These photos are the starting point for the move-out check.
When the tenant hands over the deposit, open Moving in and out, then Deposits and press Money received.

record.field: From the request to the deposit refund.

field.name: steps

ol.li: When a tenant asks to move out, it appears in Moving in and out, then Move-outs. Open it and press Acknowledge.
The tenant uploads a photo of every room from their phone.
Open the request and look at Compare the photos: move-in on the left, move-out on the right. Press Photos reviewed.

Press Open the deposit. Press Take off unpaid invoices and Add final water bill. Add a line for any damage, with a photo. Then press Prepare the refund. The tenant can now see the deductions in their portal.
Back on the move-out, press Complete the move-out. The lease ends, the unit becomes vacant and the tenant's login is turned off. If the tenant disputed a deduction, decide on it first.
Pay the tenant. Then open the deposit and press Mark as refunded. Refund within the number of days set on the building.

field.p: If the tenant disagrees with a deduction, they must write why. It appears in Deposit disputes.
